beats.headline: A postscript in another hand
beats.text: Subject exists, at first, as a postscript. Below a council letter to Ghazi, in a different script: Ghazi, you fucking idiot. She told him this would happen. They needed that artifact, without it Scolopendra cannot be defeated, and all he could think about was his cock. She does not forgive him. She was there the whole time, and she guesses she was not enough. She hopes he dies in pain. Do the right thing. Signed, Tish.

beats.headline: So you are from the college
beats.text: Princess Donut read the postscript over Crawler Carl's shoulder and took it personally. When Ghazi came round she jumped on his chest: he had Tish all along, and he left her for Lika, who is not even real. Ghazi's eyes went huge. Tish? So they were from the college? Crawler Carl advised that nobody knew the story beyond one letter. Princess Donut's closing remark on the subject, as Ghazi explained his wife: if Tish could see you now.

beats.headline: A letter addressed to her
beats.text: The pages Katia Grim took off the Mad Dune Mage open as a letter to subject. I know you hate me, but please listen. Hope is not lost. He writes that he was asked to use the box to pull the whole island into the Nothing, and refused, because all three pieces of the artifact would go with it. He sets out how the gate works. If his plan succeeds he dies, and she receives the letter with the winding box and can send another expedition.

beats.headline: Tish almost ruined everything
beats.text: Princess Donut, to the doll head of Samantha: she does feel bad for Tish, who really seemed to like him. Samantha's view differs. Tish? Tish almost ruined everything. Take me to her. Crawler Carl completed the sentence for her with the threat Samantha uses on everyone, the one about mothers, and Samantha burst into tears.

beats.headline: Samantha's arch enemy
beats.text: Larracos, the college, a visitor pass queue. Samantha rolled by Louis screaming after a woman named Tish and promising to kill her, and Katia Grim gave chase past guards carrying a Despondent debuff until she had the head cornered. Crawler Carl asked twice who the fuck Tish was. Princess Donut had forgotten about Tish entirely until that moment. Samantha, restrained: she is a woman scorned, and her need for vengeance against her arch enemy, Tish, is the only thing she knows.

beats.headline: Still at the college
beats.text: Crawler Carl reconstructs the file. Ghazi wrote to the college here in Larracos for help, and the letters showed that his ex-girlfriend, Tish, still worked there, and that he had left her for the doll. Samantha proposes to use Louis's new toy to kill her. Princess Donut rules that subject should not be held accountable; that was one hundred percent Ghazi. If she is not allowed to blow Tish up, Samantha adds, Juice Box is going to hear about Louis's affair. Louis says: what?

beats.headline: Blamed for a child
beats.text: Samantha reports that her child has died in the acid, and that she felt it go. She blames herself for her lust and her anger. She also blames subject: it is actually Tish's fault, she is quite certain, which is why afterwards she intends to plant, up at the college, the nuke she stole. Crawler Carl rules that she is not nuking anyone. Samantha moves on to how to save Louis, which is more urgent.

beats.headline: The room next to hers
beats.text: Samantha is redecorating Carl's room in the personal space, which she has claimed, since he never goes in there and she won it in the breakup. Its chandelier came from the room next to Tish's room, borrowed on an occasion Samantha does not intend to discuss, because everyone would get mad. Bucket Boy points out that it is a swing. Anything can be a chandelier, Samantha says, if it lights up and you attach it to the ceiling.
